versions.content: When development error detection is enabled for the Wdg Driver module: the watchdog servicing routine shall set the Wdg module’s state to WDG_BUSY during its execution (indicating, that the module is busy) and shall rese t the module’s state to WDG_IDLE (indicating, that the module is initialized and not busy) as last operation before it returns.
